name: Run PBT Suite & Typecheck on Engine Save
command: npm run lint && npx tsx -e "import { runPbtInvariants } from './src/engine/pbtSuite'; const res = runPbtInvariants(20261116, 100); console.log(res.map(r => r.id + ':' + r.passedCount + '/' + r.trials).join(', ')); if (!res.every(r => r.passed)) process.exit(1);"
description: Automatically verifies TypeScript types and all 400 seeded PBT invariants whenever spreadsheet, FM synth, vector plotter, or PBT engine code changes.
